segments.thag6.6:2.1: “Aladdhā cittassekaggaṃ, kāmarāgena aṭṭito [addito (syā. sī. aṭṭha.), aḍḍito (ka.)];
segments.thag6.6:2.3: Bāhā paggayha kandanto, vihārā upanikkhamiṃ [nūpanikkhamiṃ (sabbattha), dupanikkhamiṃ (?)].
segments.thag6.6:3.1: “Satthaṃ vā āharissāmi, ko attho jīvitena me;
segments.thag6.6:3.3: Kathaṃ hi sikkhaṃ paccakkhaṃ, kālaṃ kubbetha mādiso.
segments.thag6.6:6.3: Tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan”ti.
